newsitem.title: POLAND: AIB CLEARED TO UP STAKE IN WBK.
newsitem.headline: AIB CLEARED TO UP STAKE IN WBK.

text.p: The Polish Securities Commission gave the go ahead on Tuesday to Allied Irish Banks Plc's (AIB) plan to extend its equity in Wielkopolski Bank Kredytowy SA (WBK) to a majority stake, the Commission said.

The Commission said in a statement that after consulting the government's anti-trust body it had no objections against AIB subsidiary AIB European Investment Ltd raising its stake in WBK from the current 36.3 percent to a stake giving it more than 50 percent of votes at general shareholders' meetings.

In September AIB said it wanted to raise its 36.3 percent stake of WBK to a majority within three years from February 1997 by buying up to 23.9 percent of WBK currently held by the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD).
